purpose: Repair the accepted Template Catalog from merged PR #196 without reopening unrelated scope: canonicalize supported capability keys before immutable Template persistence and add append-only reversible Song Template deselection while preserving provider-neutral save/select/relaunch behavior and consumer action protections.

lineage.outcome: The accepted Template Catalog persists only canonical supported capability keys and lets an Artist explicitly return a Song to No Template selected through durable append-only history.
lineage.capability: Provider-neutral reusable Song Template catalog and reversible explicit selection

why_now: Parent incident #206 requires the known merged-product findings from PR #196/#181/#200/#204 to be repaired forward or safely reverted before closure. The trusted-integrity child is now post-merge verified as main a79882c4aee543259e648f6e367f7f6fa57ffed5 with zero dangling Actions. #207 is selected first because it is a bounded consumer-visible repair with the smallest direct dependency cone among #207-#210.

implementation_contract.canonical_capabilities: Keep the generic capability resolver provider-neutral, but add an explicit canonical product capability-key vocabulary in the existing n0te2/capabilities.py semantic owner. Template input may normalize deterministic case/whitespace to a known canonical key; unknown, typo or natural-language capability text must fail before immutable persistence.
implementation_contract.selection_reversibility: Represent deselection as an append-only selection-history event rather than deletion or mutation. Existing selection rows remain durable; the latest clear event yields No Template selected and a later explicit selection may select again.
implementation_contract.schema_migration: Upgrade existing Template catalog schema safely so historical v1 definition/selection rows are preserved exactly while the selection event can encode a clear state. New profiles create the repaired schema directly.
implementation_contract.consumer_binding: Expose explicit clear selection only when a Template is selected, with the same active-Song, one-shot trusted action, Host/Origin/CSRF and stale-context protections as selection. Clear grants no provider/DAW execution authority.
implementation_contract.preserve: Preserve accepted Template save, browse, select and relaunch continuity, immutable Template definitions, Artist/Song binding, provider-neutral semantics and existing security boundaries.
implementation_contract.authority: This repair grants no provider write, DAW instantiation, Version/Session mutation, public/human/artist acceptance, spend, publication, merge or external-action authority.

completion_proof: canonical supported capability input is persisted using the exact canonical key; deterministic casing/whitespace may resolve to that key while unknown/typo/free-prose capability input fails before persistence
existing v1 Template catalog data migrates without definition/selection loss and the repaired schema remains integrity-checked
select then clear appends history, preserves the prior selection event and makes current_selection/selected_template return no active Template
clear survives relaunch and a later explicit reselect remains possible
consumer clear action is shown only for an active selection and rejects replay, stale Song context and hostile Origin with no provider/Version/Session side effect
fresh exact-head Linux, macOS and Windows Governance/full regression/consumer smoke/evidence pass
terminal substantive and Codex review complete on the exact final head, followed by guarded merge and exact-main post-merge verification

public deployment or human/artist acceptance authority
